statement: ∀ (f : Space n × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {p | 0 < p.2} → (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Space n × ℝ => deriv (fun r => f (p.1,r)) p.2) {p | 0 < p.2}) ∧ (∀ a : Space n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : Space n × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y,p.2)) p.1 a) {p | 0 < p.2}) ∧ (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → deriv (fun r => f (x,r)) t = fderiv ℝ f (x,t) (0,1) ∧ ∀ a : Space n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y,t)) x a = fderiv ℝ f (x,t) (a,0))
proof:
intro f hf
have ho : IsOpen {p : Space n × ℝ | 0 < p.2} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd
have hid := @yui_aux_0002 n m u q h_T001 f hf
have he : ∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → deriv (fun r => f (x,r)) t = fderiv ℝ f (x,t) (0,1) ∧ ∀ a : Space n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (y,t)) x a = fderiv ℝ f (x,t) (a,0) := by
  intro x t ht
  refine ⟨(hid x t ht).1.deriv, ?_⟩
  intro a
  rw [(hid x t ht).2.fderiv]
  simp
have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) {p | 0 < p.2} := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen ho (by simp)
refine ⟨?_, ?_, he⟩
· exact (hD.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := ((0 : Space n), (1 : ℝ))))).congr (fun p hp => (he p.1 p.2 hp).1.symm)
· intro a
  exact (hD.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := (a, (0 : ℝ))))).congr (fun p hp => ((he p.1 p.2 hp).2 a).symm)
